title: HER2-positive breast cancer: targeted therapy and cardiac safety

steps.tx: The definitive first-line standard of care for **metastatic HER2-positive** breast cancer is **docetaxel**, **trastuzumab**, and **pertuzumab**, which established median overall survival of nearly 5 years in the **CLEOPATRA trial**. This triplet combination achieved an extraordinary median overall survival exceeding 57 months, establishing persistent dual-HER2 blockade as the worldwide standard. Following docetaxel completion, dual monoclonal antibody maintenance is continued until objective disease progression.
steps.say: The definitive first-line standard of care for metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer is docetaxel, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab, which established median overall survival of nearly 5 years in the CLEOPATRA trial. Following chemotherapy, dual antibody maintenance is continued until objective disease progression.

steps.tx: Adjuvant human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 blockade revolutionized breast cancer survival. One year of **adjuvant** **trastuzumab** combined with chemotherapy reduces recurrence risk by 50% and mortality by **33%** in early HER2-positive breast cancer. Established across landmark randomized prospective trials including HERA and NSABP B-31, 12 months of adjuvant trastuzumab remains the worldwide standard duration, whereas shorter durations of 6 months demonstrated inferior disease-free survival in non-inferiority trials.

steps.tx: Dual antibody receptor inhibition further reduces recurrence in high-risk node-positive early disease. Dual HER2 blockade with **trastuzumab** and **pertuzumab** combined with chemotherapy significantly improves invasive disease-free survival in the **APHINITY** trial, particularly in node-positive patients. By simultaneously preventing receptor homodimerization and ligand-induced HER2-HER3 heterodimerization, dual antibody blockade prevents activation of downstream mitogenic signaling, generating substantial long-term protection against distant metastatic relapse.

steps.tx: Preoperative systemic therapy provides a real-time in vivo biomarker of biological responsiveness. **Pathological complete response** pCR after neoadjuvant dual **anti-HER2 therapy** and taxane chemotherapy occurs in 60% of patients, strongly correlating with excellent long-term event-free survival. Eradication of all invasive tumour cells from breast parenchyma and axillary lymph nodes confirms chemosensitivity, whereas residual invasive disease directs adjuvant therapy escalation.

steps.tx: Targeted payload delivery overcomes therapeutic resistance in patients failing neoadjuvant therapy. In the randomized phase 3 **KATHERINE** trial, adjuvant **trastuzumab emtansine** T-DM1 reduced the risk of invasive recurrence or death by **50%** compared with trastuzumab in patients with residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant therapy. Patients with non-pCR at surgery switch from naked trastuzumab to 14 cycles of intravenous T-DM1, establishing targeted antibody-drug conjugates as essential post-surgical therapy.

steps.tx: Next-generation antibody-drug conjugates have established new standards in metastatic second-line therapy. In the pivotal randomized **DESTINY-Breast03** trial, **trastuzumab deruxtecan** T-DXd carrying an exatecan derivative topoisomerase I inhibitor payload with a drug-to-antibody ratio of **8** significantly reduced progression or death risk compared to T-DM1. T-DXd demonstrated unequivocal superiority in median progression-free survival, becoming the undisputed preferred second-line global standard of care.

rows: High DAR: 8 payload molecules per antibody

steps.tx: Antibodies latch onto surface **HER2 receptors**, then the membrane folds inward and carries the cargo inside by **receptor intake**. Lysosomal enzymes snip the linker and free the **toxic payload**, a topoisomerase blocker that shreds DNA in the nucleus. Because the freed drug can leak outward, nearby **neighbour cells** die too, which explains the strong effect even when receptor levels vary across the tumour.
steps.say: The antibody binds HER2 on the cell surface and the cell draws the complex inward. Inside the lysosome the linker is cut and the topoisomerase blocking payload is released to fragment DNA and kill the cell. Freed payload also diffuses to adjacent cells, giving a bystander effect that helps when neighbouring cells carry fewer receptors. This design underpins the strong benefit seen over older conjugates.

vis.alt: Antibodies binding surface receptors are drawn inside the cell where released payload damages DNA and nearby cells.

steps.tx: Intracranial central nervous system disease requires small-molecule targeted therapies that penetrate the blood-brain barrier. **Tucatinib** is an oral, highly selective HER2 tyrosine kinase inhibitor that, when added to **trastuzumab** and **capecitabine** in the HER2CLIMB trial, significantly prolonged progression-free and overall survival in patients with pretreated HER2-positive metastatic disease and active **brain metastases**. Tucatinib combination therapy reduced the risk of death by one-third in patients with cerebral dissemination.

nodes.label: 52% Reduction in CNS Progression or Death (HER2CLIMB)

steps.tx: Cardiac safety surveillance remains mandatory throughout therapeutic anti-HER2 administration. **Trastuzumab cardiotoxicity** type II is not dose-dependent, characteristically non-structural, and typically reversible upon drug cessation. Regular monitoring of **left ventricular ejection fraction** LVEF via echocardiography is required every 3 months during therapy, holding treatment if LVEF drops below 50% or by at least **10%** from baseline to permit myocardial recovery and initiation of cardioprotective ACE inhibitors.

steps.tx: HER2 (human epidermal growth factor receptor 2) is a growth receptor that, when present in excess, pushes breast tumours towards more aggressive behaviour. **Trastuzumab** is a monoclonal antibody aimed at HER2 and forms the core of treatment. Its chief dose-limiting adverse effect is **cardiotoxicity**, so heart function, usually tracked through **left ventricular ejection fraction** (LVEF) monitoring, must be followed throughout therapy. **Pertuzumab** adds a second layer of HER2 blockade on top of trastuzumab.
